name: Forellenhof
beschreibung: The Forellenhof is located in Schwendt in the district of Kitzbühel – nestled in the Kaiserwinkl holiday region between the Wilder Kaiser and the Chiemgau Alps. The quaint mountain village of Schwendt is considered a quiet starting point for hikes and walks; paths into the surrounding countryside lead right past the house. According to the existing entry, guests can expect simple rooms with views of the mountains and meadows as well as an in-house restaurant serving regional fish dishes. The small, manageable house is geared towards those seeking peace and quiet. The region around Kössen, Walchsee, Schwendt and Rettenschöss offers an extensive network of hiking and cycling trails, cross-country ski trails in winter and proximity to the Kaiserwinkl ski areas. Anyone looking to get away from everyday life in Schwendt will find nature, fresh air and Tyrolean hospitality right on their doorstep.
